articles.title: FromSoftware's Bloodborne Is Still Selling Hundreds of Thousands of Copies, Over a Decade After Launch
articles.summary: All FromSoftware games rule, but Bloodborne has the coolest vibes. Perhaps it shouldn't come as a surprise, then, that it's still selling hundreds of thousands of copies a year despite being over a decade old.
articles.body:
All FromSoftware games rule, but Bloodborne has the coolest vibes. You’re dripping in Victorian garb, flanked by gothic architecture, and stalked by Lovecraftian terrors across cobbled streets that run red with each sword swing, wielding weapons that shift and transform mid-combo, parrying with a shotgun — it’s just sick. Perhaps it shouldn't come as a surprise, then, that it's still selling hundreds of thousands of copies a year despite being over a decade old.

According to Alinea Analytics estimates, the PS4 exclusive has reportedly sold more than 251,000 copies this year alone. Analyst Rhys Elliott took to social media to note that the game has sold to an estimated 10.4 million copies since going on sale in March 2015, generating around $317 million in revenue.

On top of the impressive sales, an estimated half a million played Bloodborne in October through PS Plus, Sony’s video game subscription service. Bloodborne continues to be hugely popular among fans of FromSoftware games, the data suggests. Of those nearly 500,000 players, 12% also played Elden Ring this month, while 6% also played Dark Souls 3 and 5% also played Sekiro. “There’s a cohort of gamers who are always bouncing between different From games. Can’t blame them, especially with this one," Elliott said.

Bloodborne is one of the few PS4 exclusives that never got a PS5 update and is still (officially at least) locked at 30fps, despite public demand for a Bloodborne remaster. Modders have managed to get Bloodborne running at 120fps on higher resolutions than previously possible on PS5 , however.

The now-shuttered Bluepoint , the studio behind the successful Shadow of the Colossus and Demon's Souls remakes, reportedly pitched a Bloodborne remake last year that was rejected not by Sony, as many had thought, but by FromSoftware itself.

Bloodborne's status has long been in limbo, with various individuals with ties to the project sharing conflicting thoughts on what can be made of it. Back in 2024 , FromSoftware director Hidetaka Miyazaki said it was "not in my place" to talk about a Bloodborne remake because FromSoftware does not own the IP. He also told Eurogamer at the time that the game would benefit from a release on modern hardware .

Then, the following year, PlayStation's Shuhei Yoshida offered a theory on KindaFunny as to what was going on with Bloodborne that might have matched up with what happened to Bluepoint's pitch: "Bloodborne has always been the most asked thing. And people wonder why we haven’t really done anything, even an update or a remaster. Should be easy, right? The company is known for doing so many remasters, right, some people get frustrated.

"I have only my personal theory to that situation. I left first-party so I don’t know what’s going on, but my theory is, you know because I remember, you know, Miyazaki-san really, really loved Bloodborne, you know, what he created. So I think he is interested, but he’s so successful and he’s so busy, so he doesn’t want, he cannot do himself, but he does not want anyone else to touch it. So that’s my theory. And the PlayStation team respect his wish. So that’s my guess, right? Theory. I am not revealing any secret information, to be clear."

There are some signs of life, though. Sony announced an R-rated animated Bloodborne movie earlier this year, produced by YouTuber JackSepticEye.

As for FromSoftware itself, it's gearing up to launch the recently delayed Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive, The Duskbloods , next year. Its most recent game is co-op spinoff Elden Ring: Nightreign . Miyazaki recently reassured fans that the developer is still focused on single-player games. In December 2024, Miyazaki said FromSoftware was not considering making Elden Ring 2 , but wouldn't shut down the possibility in the future. If not, there is an Elden Ring movie in the works.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

articles.title: Rings of Power, Blade Runner 2099, and 8 More of Our Most Anticipated TV Shows and Movies Streaming in November
articles.summary: From a WWII football game to a Replicant revolt and the final season of Yellowjackets, here are our picks for what to stream this month.
articles.body:
As they say, nothin’ lasts forever, and we both know hearts can change, but it’s hard to hold a candle to the cold November streaming shows and movies we can’t wait to watch this month.

…Does that make any sense? Perhaps, perhaps not. But the important part here is that there are a slew of new movies and TV shows coming your way this month that are well worth your time. That includes the return of Prime Video’s big fantasy series (sorry, not Wheel of Time) which finally gets to the good stuff, a Disney+ series that has managed to lap its theatrical progenitor, and the final time we’ll get to see Paramount+’s cannibal soccer team in action.

All that plus a few biopics, an all-star heist thriller, and even one of the wildest shows Netflix has streamed in a good long time. Without further delay, let’s get into the list of our 10 most anticipated movies and TV shows hitting just like the cold November rain.

(Note: this list is presented in release date order.)

Created by Quinn Shephard — the mind behind the well-regarded Hulu series Under the Bridge as well as director of the underrated Not Okay — Netflix’s new satirical YA drama, The Body, is not based on the Stephen King story that inspired Stand By Me. It is, however, a heady mix of Euphoria, Bring It On, Cruel Intentions, Yellowjackets, and maybe The Exorcist.

It’s a “maybe” on the last part as the show is being coy about whether it’s supernatural or not, as a cheerleading squad at a Catholic school deals with an accident that downs one of their own, with events spiraling out into cult-like behavior with shades of the Salem Witch trials. It’s also set in 2004 with a bangin’ early oughts soundtrack and a slew of new talent who are likely to blow up after this show, which seems perfectly aimed at fans of Elite, The Society, and other Netflix shows of its ilk.

The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 (November 11)

Those nasty hobbitses are back at it again with the latest season of the Prime Video prequel The Rings of Power , and this time — you won’t believe this — they’re finally, actually doing Lord of the Rings stuff.

That stuff includes Sexy Sauron (Charlie Vickers) forging the One Ring in the fires of Mount Doom, Gandalf (Daniel Weyman) taking on a Dark Wizard (Ciáran Hinds), and Galadriel (Morfydd Clark) looking even muddier and more serious than usual.

But more exciting are the new cast members, which include Jamie Campbell Bower as Celeborn, the husband of Galadriel, and — bizarrely — Simon Pegg as the voice of the Balrog. On the latter, if the Balrog talks like Pegg in Shaun of the Dead, all the show’s early sins are forgiven.

Apple TV viewers missing real-time thriller Hijack might want to tune into 12 12 12 , which isn’t exactly real-time though it does deal with time. In the series created by Jim Keeble and Dudi Appleton, we’re told that any heist takes 12 months of planning and 12 hours to execute, and if the thieves aren’t caught in 12 days, they’ll never be caught.

So guess what? Taking place in those three timelines, we follow mastermind Paul Galvin (Jamie Dornan), who’s been forced into a massive Swiss bank heist by his brother as he sets it up, executes it, and is pursued the entire time by FBI agent Jack Strickland (Anthony Mackie), who has a very personal reason for trying to take Galvin down.

Around the edges, you’ve also got a great supporting cast including Kali Reis (True Detective: Night Country) and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson (NOS4A2, Severance) as members of Galvin’s gang. The real draw here is the cat-and-mouse between Dornan and Mackie. Also of note? Four of the eight episodes are directed by The Falcon and the Winter Soldier’s Kari Skogland, so reuniting her with Mackie is (hopefully) redemption for the mixed reception to the Marvel series.

In one of the truly more bizarre-looking biopics this year — and that includes the Sylvester Stallone biopic I Play Rocky and the chocolate drama Hershey — Nicolas Cage takes on the role of the man who sold a million game cartridges (among other things) in this new movie by David O. Russell, his first since 2022’s Amsterdam.

Madden , which hits theaters on November 11 and then streaming on Prime Video a week later, also stars Christian Bale, Kathryn Hahn, Shane Gillis, Sienna Miller, and John Mulaney as the guy who has the brainstorm to turn John Madden into a video game.

Why has O. Russell been so infrequent in his filmography? Great question! At least part of that is the director of movies like I Heart Huckabees and Silver Linings Playbook has been accused of sexual assault and abuse by crew members and cast members on various productions. One time, he even reportedly punched a Sony exec in the stomach at an Oscar party!

On Madden, O. Russell was accused of using a racial slur on set and attempting to put it into the script, causing a walkout by the crew. That was disputed by Amazon, but of note, the film’s trailer ends with a “jokey” conversation about how they can’t use the “N” word. Boom?

Netflix’s latest docudrama focuses on the romantic relationship and eventual imprisonment of Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison (no relation to Larry or David, or Larry David) over stealing billions of dollars through their cryptocurrency company, FTX.

That’s the simple version, but the drama created by Graham Moore (The Imitation Game) is yet another attempt to humanize people who bilked regular folks out of their money, or at least explain what got them there. Per the title, Bankman-Fried and Ellison started with the purpose of being ethical billionaires and went ever-so-slightly wrong along the way.

The series stars Anthony Boyle as Bankman-Fried and Julia Garner as Ellison, acting and looking like they’re in a relatively serious prestige TV version of The Big Bang Theory. Alex Lawther (Alien: Earth) also appears as Sam’s best friend, and Heated Rivalry star Hudson Williams pops up in a brief role as well. If The Social Reckoning didn’t do it for you, maybe The Altruists will? After all, you can’t get to 500 million bitcoins without making a few enemies.

Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3 (November 20)

The third season of the hit Disney+ adaptation of Rick Riordan’s books manages to pull off something unprecedented — adapting the third novel in the series, which the movie versions never got to do.

Based on The Titan’s Curse, the eight-episode season finds Annabeth (Leah Sava Jeffries) captured, so Percy (Walker Scobell) and the gang head off in pursuit, grappling with whether they can save their friend and Olympus at the same time.

The big “addition” is Tamara Smart as Thalia, another child of the “Big Three” Olympians who serves as both rival and ally of Percy. She recurred in Season 2, but now joins the show full time. But for those wondering which guest stars will be stopping by? Hubert Smielecki as Apollo, Jennifer Beals as Demeter, Kate McKinnon as Aphrodite, and Ming-Na Wen as Hera.

When the final episode of Yellowjackets ends on Paramount+, will we be saying: “Oh, they ate”? We’ve still got a few months until we find out for sure, but the series that seemed to start as a simple survival-in-the-woods drama has become something wilder, weirder, twistier, and much grosser as the show continued.

The show started with a girls’ soccer team crashing in the wilderness and then surviving by eating each other and forming a cult that may or may not be supernatural. The big twist in this final season? They’re rescued, some against their will, and we get to see the aftermath of that as well as what’s happening in the present with the survivors.

There’s a lot the show needs to resolve (the original plan was to go five seasons), so how will this stellar cast in both eras wrap things up? We can’t wait to bite in and find out.

Not to be confused with the movie Digger or Andy Samberg’s animated Digman!, Dig is co-created by Mike Schur and Amy Poehler based on Kate Myers’ novel, Excavations.

In the 10-episode Peacock comedy, Poehler plays the head of an archaeological excavation that discovers something so important, they get stuck in the middle of an international conspiracy. It also stars Hugh Laurie and Geraldine Viswanathan, among others, but the big news is the reteaming of Schur and Poehler after the success of Parks and Recreation.

Perhaps of note, the first season of Parks and Rec (aka the only Not Good season) was all focused around a massive hole in the ground as well, so one wonders if history will repeat itself here or if they’ve learned their lesson from the first time around. Either way, prepare to dig into what might be your new favorite show.

It’s crazy to think they’ve already made two thousand and ninety-nine Blade Runners before Marvel could get its act together for a single MCU Blade movie.

But seriously folks, Blade Runner 2099 is the first live-action TV extension of Ridley Scott’s Blade Runner, which continued with Blade Runner 2049 and now jumps forward another 50 years to a world gone topsy-turvy where the android Replicants are in charge and humans are picking up the scraps.

Enter Cora (Hunter Schafer), a human pretending to be a Replicant (depending on which version of the original you watch, either a flip on the premise or right in line with it), and her Replicant partner Olwen (Michelle Yeoh), who is about to be turned into scrap. Do they get embroiled in a seemingly simple case that spins wildly out of control and turns out to be a massive conspiracy? We haven’t seen the show yet, but you can bet that will happen… just like tears in rain.

Based on real-life events as detailed in the 2022 book by journalist Buzz Bissinger (who is not a mosquito, despite his name making it sound like he’s a mosquito), this new Netflix movie focuses on a football game played in the waning days of World War II between two groups of marines.

It comes from a guy who knows a little bit about both war and football — Peter Berg , the man behind Friday Night Lights, Lone Survivor, and uh, Battleship, among others. And as usual with films of this type, the cast is stacked with a who’s-who that includes Nicholas Galitzine, Bill Skarsgård, Ray Nicholson, and others.

By the way, if it sounds familiar, that’s because the movie is getting a rare month-long theatrical release from Netflix as the streamer’s relationship with movie theaters evolves. Seems like we’re getting mo’ squito instead of less squito.

articles.title: Fortnite's Ultra-Rare Pirate Shop Token Hunt Sparks Wave of Profiteering and eBay Listings
articles.summary: Fortnite Players Are Doing Things Epic Would Probably Prefer They Didn't to Try to Get the Ultra Rare Pirate Shop Token.
articles.body:
Update: Article updated to add a statement from Epic.

Fortnite's recently launched One Piece crossover event sent players hunting for a rare Pirate Shop Token that would let them plunder the item shop for free. Those lucky enough to find the token can use it to claim almost everything available for free for a two week period (real-money offers, gifting and Battle Pass rewards aren’t allowed). Claimed items remain permanently on the player’s account.

But, perhaps inevitably, players are now doing things that developer Epic Games would probably prefer the didn't in a bid to get ahead, sharing exploits, selling tools to automatically farm the token, and even offering to chaperone other players for a fee.

There’s no official drop rate, but players have estimated you get the token in one out of every 700,000 chests. Like I said, it’s rare. Players have found ways to expedite the process of triggering the drop. Current methods include using grenades and cannon balls to destroy chests inside locked vaults, so they can open many chests at once without going through the effort of getting a key.

One player shared a screenshot of an overlay that shows them where all the chests are in a match, while offering to help people get the token, for a paid fee. Clearly, this is not intended gameplay.

i can carry people for pirate access token ez for $ already helped 3 people lmk — joki (@jokifv) November 2, 2026

i can carry people for pirate access token ez for $ already helped 3 people lmk

Multiple accounts on eBay are also hoping to cash in, listing Fortnite accounts with Pirate Shop access for thousands of dollars. There are currently no bids on the listings — one asking for $9,000 and offering bids, another asking for $10,000 or nearest offer — but that might change as the season comes to a close on December 4.

Epic’s terms of service explicitly prohibit the buying and selling of Fortnite accounts, as well as cheating or exploiting, so anyone attempting to cash in could end up with an account ban. In such a case, they’d lose access to the account — this could also happen after you buy the account, or the previous owner could contact support and claim the account is stolen. In other words, don’t spend $10,000 on some Fortnite skins.

"Buying an account or using fake tools is a scam," Epic said in a statement . "This is just like any of the chests in Battle Royale, so every player has an equal opportunity to find Pirate Shop Access."

If you're wondering how to unlock the Pirate Shop for free items (legitimately!), we've got a full explainer on it, as well as breakdown of the entire Treasure Hunters mini-season . You can also keep up with the weekly rewards that are dropped at random from the treasure chests , and use our handy checklist to track down all pirate-themed Sprites .

articles.body:
One of the first side quests you will run into in the Crimson Forest is Honor Among Thieves. This is a missable quest, unlocked by killing a very specific enemy.

The enemy is located just south of the Outlaw Trap bell. Head in the opposite direction of Jing Ye, The Outlaw , and up the hillside on the left.

Here you can find an enemy which will drop the note Blood Letter From The Nimble Thief, which is a part of the Wulin Tales Book.

Here are the steps to complete the quest:

Speak to the Gentle Thief at the Thieves' Camp

Progress onwards and defeat Jing Ye, The Outlaw. A full boss guide can be found here .

In the Thieves' Camp, inside the first tent on your left, you can find the Gentle Thief. Speak to Him.

The Gentle Thief will ask you for three answers to questions based on the information in the Blood Letter From The Nimble Thief. You can get these wrong and try again, but you need to correctly answer all three questions in a row.

The letter didn't mention the child. It seems his fate is unknown

Upon answering the questions correctly, you will get the Silent Wrap accessory and complete the quest.

articles.title: PlayStation’s Black Friday Sale Is Live With Big Discounts on Digital PS5 Games
articles.summary: PlayStation’s Black Friday sale is live, with big discounts on digital PS5 games.
articles.body:
It’s official: Black Friday season is upon us. As Sony announced yesterday , the PlayStation Store has kicked off its Black Friday sale (you can see the whole sale here ). The sale runs November 4 - 30, dropping prices on thousands of digital PS5 games. These range from older titles you’d expect to get discounts to new 2026 games like Wolverine, Control Resonant, Silent Hill: Townfall, and many more. Let’s take a look.

Marvel's Wolverine - Digital Deluxe Edition

Control Resonant - Digital Deluxe Edition

The Blood of Dawnwalker - Eclipse Edition

Before we dive in, it’s worth noting that these deals are just the beginning of the Black Friday season, and they may not be the best deals we'll see on these games. With Black Friday coming in just a few weeks, other retailers will certainly have some of these games on sale as well, likely for lower prices as the month progresses. So keep that in mind when planning your purchases.

Also, Sony said its Black Friday sale will run November 4 - 30; however, many game pages in this sale say the discounts will only last until November 21. I’m not 100% sure why that is, but I have to assume another wave of discounts will go live as we get closer to Black Friday. With that out of the way, let’s look at what’s on sale.

The biggest first-party PS5 game of the fall is Marvel’s Wolverine, from Insomniac, the makers of the Spider-Man PS5 games. It’s a fun (and very gory) single-player action game that tells a good story, though our reviewer scored it a 6/10 . Only the digital deluxe edition is on sale, but the discount actually makes it cheaper than the standard edition by $10. In addition to get base game, it includes a host of exclusive suits and claw skins, as well as some in-game help in the form of Technique Points.

On the other hand, if you have a PS5 with a disc drive, you can get a pre-owned copy of the standard edition on sale at GameStop for $38.99 right now. That's an example of other retailers possibly offering bigger discounts than you'll find in the PlayStation Store's sale. The more flexible you can be in terms of format and retailer, the better deals you'll be able to score this month.

As for other games on sale, Control Resonant is another big new game of the fall. And once again, it’s the digital deluxe edition that’s on sale instead of the standard edition. It comes with an extra outfit, a starter resource bundle, and a digital artbook and soundtrack. The deluxe edition of 007: First Light is on sale for 50% off; it also includes some in-game outfits and extras.

If standard editions are more your speed and you dig horror, you can pick up Silent Hill: Townfall for a cool 20% off. Beast of Reincarnation is on sale for 25% off. And a whole lot more games are discounted as well.

But once again, if you want the best deals possible, you’ll likely find bigger discounts in the weeks to come. If you want my advice, for now just buy the games you’ll start playing very soon. For everything else, make a list of what games you want and keep an eye out for all the PS5 game sales to come.

Chris Reed is a senior commerce editor and deals expert for IGN. He also runs IGN's LEGO coverage and maintains the upcoming release dates articles for video games , LEGO sets , and 4K Blu-rays . You can follow him on Bluesky .

articles.title: Democrat Mocks Former Bungie Composer Marty O'Donnell With Halo Monk Chant Tweet After U.S. Midterm Elections Victory
articles.summary: Republican Marty O'Donnell has lost his bid for Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District at the U.S. midterm elections despite a last-minute endorsement from Donald Trump, putting his political future in doubt.
articles.body:
Republican Marty O'Donnell has lost his bid for Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District at the U.S. midterm elections despite a last-minute endorsement from Donald Trump, putting his political future in doubt.

O'Donnell is best-known to gamers as the composer of the original Halo games and Destiny at Bungie, but following his retirement from video games, he launched a career in politics and a bid for Congress. This year, O'Donnell launched a campaign to — with Trump’s support — unseat Nevada's 3rd Congressional District Democrat incumbent Susie Lee .

Unfortunately for O'Donnell, he lost the vote 38.6% to Lee’s 59.1%. 146,863 voted for Lee, with 95,845 voting for O'Donnell. The result came hot on the heels of a tweet endorsement from Trump himself , viewed 1.8 million times, in which the President called O’Donnell an “America First Patriot.”

“Marty is running against Susie Lee, a true Radical Left Extremist who does not represent the Values of Southern Nevada. Susie Lee wants Open Borders, Men playing in Women’s Sports, Transgender for Everyone, Defund the Police, and she wants to take away your Second Amendment, meaning, your guns. She voted AGAINST the Biggest Tax Cut in History (including NO TAX ON TIPS!), and fought ferociously to knock out Rural Healthcare, a big factor in Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District.

“In contrast, Marty O’Donnell is a World Class Composer and Entrepreneur who knows the America First Policies required to Create GREAT Jobs, Cut Taxes and Regulations, Promote NO TAX ON TIPS, Advance MADE IN THE U.S.A., Unleash American Energy DOMINANCE, and Champion our Nation’s Golden Age. As your next Congressman, Marty will fight tirelessly to Keep our Border SECURE, Stop Migrant Crime, Ensure LAW AND ORDER, Strengthen our Brave Military/Veterans, and Protect our always under siege Second Amendment.

“Marty O'Donnell has my Complete and Total Endorsement to be the next Representative from Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District. GET OUT AND VOTE FOR MARTY — HE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN!”

Following the win, Lee tagged O'Donnell in a tweet which declared: “Enjoy your retirement.” The tweet includes a video of Halo fans singing the iconic monk chant from the game, with O'Donnell’s tweet, “Well, I never wanted to be a politician and now I don’t have to be. Yay!” from 2024 overlaid. That 2024 tweet followed a similarly bruising political failure at the same Congressional seat, which touches parts of Las Vegas.

Enjoy your retirement @MartyTheElder — Susie Lee (@SusieLeeNV) November 4, 2026

O’Donnell, clearly upset by Lee’s tweet, responded : “Susie has a lot of class. And it’s all low.”

What went wrong for O’Donnell this time? Apart from the midterm results being disastrous overall for the Republicans due to what is a clear rejection of Trump’s recent policies, Trump’s tariffs have hit O’Donnell's district hard, with Canadian tourism to Sin City down by 17% .

Collaborating with Michael Salvatori, O'Donnell composed the score of numerous Bungie games, from 1997's Myth to the classic sounds of Halo: Combat Evolved, in a lengthy tenure that ended with his work for 2014's Destiny.

2014 also saw O'Donnell fired from Bungie, resulting in a legal tussle over witheld pay. Bungie later initiated its own legal dispute with O'Donnell in 2021, after the composer uploaded unreleased Destiny music to YouTube.

Recent years have seen O'Donnell demonstrate an increasing interest in politics, after a lengthy period spent establishing his own game development studio, Highwire Games, that worked on VR title Golem back in 2019, and controversial shooter Six Days in Fallujah, which launched in early access form in 2023.

O’Donnell’s political future is now unclear, although perhaps after his second defeat in Nevada in two years, he may now actually enjoy his retirement.

articles.summary: IGN can exclusively reveal that Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest will be available on digital, 4K UHD, Blu-ray, and DVD on December 15, 2026. We can also reveal an exclusive clip and the new box art for the feature-length animated sequel from DC, Warner Bros. Animation, and Warner Bros. Home Entertainment.
articles.body:
IGN can exclusively reveal that Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest will be available on digital, 4K UHD, Blu-ray, and DVD on December 15, 2026.

We can also reveal an exclusive clip and the new box art for the feature-length animated sequel from DC, Warner Bros. Animation, and Warner Bros. Home Entertainment.

“Batman lies broken at the hands of the villainous mastermind Bane. With Bruce Wayne paralyzed from the waist down and unable to continue as Batman, a new successor must be chosen to defend Gotham City,” according to the film’s official plot synopsis. “Jean-Paul Valley, the man also known as Azrael, must take up the mantle of the Batman. But will his more violent methods be enough to stop Bane?”

The clip embedded below features a chase sequence and brutal hand-to-hand fight between Nightwing (voiced by Mike Prater) and Jean-Paul Valley/Azrael (voiced by Pablo Schreiber).

Nightwing fights for his life against Azrael in this exclusive clip from Knightquest:

Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest also stars the voices of Anson Mount (Star Trek: Strange New Worlds) as Bruce Wayne/Batman and Michael Mando (Spider-Man: Brand New Day) as Bane.

The film – which runs 76 minutes and is rated R for strong bloody violence – is directed by Jeff Wamester and written by Jeremy Adams based on characters from DC. Batman was created by Bob Kane with Bill Finger. Rick Morales serves as Supervising Producer alongside Producers Jim Krieg and Kimberly S. Moreau. Sam Register and Michael E. Uslan are Executive Producers.

The digital, 4K UHD, and Blu-ray releases of Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest will contain the following special features:

Explore the creative process involved in adapting and redesigning the 90’s-era comic book character Azrael for a modern animated retelling.

The moral dilemma at the heart of Part 2 takes center stage as cast, crew and DC experts discuss the age-old question confronting Batman and Azrael.

The new box art and images from the film can be found via the gallery below:

Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest Images

Knightquest is a sequel to Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall , which was released in June. In his review , IGN’s Jesse Schedeen gave that film a score of 9/10, writing:

“Batman: Knightfall Part 1 - Knightfall is a strong return to form for DC’s direct-to-video movie line. The first part of this animated trilogy succeeds in cutting through the fat and adapting the essential core of a classic Batman crossover. It paints a vivid psychological portrait of both Batman and his latest arch-nemesis. The film also looks great and boasts a talented voice cast that brings this venerable source material to life. This new DC animated trilogy is off to a great start.”

Batman: Knightfall Part 3 will be available in 2027.

articles.title: Valve Says It's Seen a 'Significant Increase' in Steam Game Submissions in Recent Months, Amid 'AI Slop' Claims
articles.summary: Valve’s approval process has always taken a bit of time, but it’s taking much longer lately because of the staggering volume of games hoping to launch on the platform — an issue that’s only grown with the advent of generative AI.
articles.body:
Valve’s approval process has always taken a bit of time, but it’s taking much longer lately because of the staggering volume of games hoping to launch on the platform — an issue that’s only grown with the advent of generative AI.

As of November 2026, approximately 24,299 games have been released on Steam this year alone, compared to 10 years ago when around 4,500 games launched across the entire year of 2016.

Unless you’re a major publisher with a proven track record, all games must undergo Valve’s testing process to make sure they’re fit for Steam and don’t riddle players’ computers with malware. But many games are now missing their release dates because of this backlog.

The issue has gotten so bad that Valve put out an official statement acknowledging the issue. “We've seen a significant increase in submissions for store page and build review in recent months, and have spent the last several weeks working to scale our process to match it,” Valve said.

“Though we still have a ways to go, we want to share the initial improvements that have shipped in the past weeks. The changes are designed to help more developers pass build review the first time, and cut down on re-reviews for basic functional issues.”

Usually it takes Valve 3-5 business days to review a game, but the average is now 12 business days. Some of the delay is due to developers not being ready, games being rejected or having to be retested. Valve left a series of tips for developers to pass approvals the first time.

"We've heard from a lot of developers and know how stressful it's been having to wait for review build updates longer than expected," Valve said. "More improvements are coming to the build review process, but these initial changes are a great starting point."

Valve didn’t address the AI issue in the post, but the issue has grown to the point where Valve employees are being asked how Steam plans to address the issue. Valve’s Steam Business Team took to the stage at the recent Steam Indie Connect event in Korea and took questions from an audience of game developers. During the chat, the issue of Steam being flooded with AI slop and knockoff AI clones came up, and Valve said it was still trying to figure out how to navigate this new world.

At the time, Valve said there are no plans to outright ban AI games from Steam, and suggested developers do more to stand out so their games can’t be easily cloned.

Steam currently requires developers to disclose AI usage, giving customers the option to vote with their wallets. Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney doesn’t like this at all, calling it a “political message.” Indie storefront Itch recently deleted what it called “terabytes of AI slop” from its store, which made it difficult for users to find the things they were looking for.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

If it sounds like exactly the kind of Apple smartwatch you've been looking for, this is a great time to buy.

articles.body:
The reviews are in, and critics agree that the new remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a winner. Seriously, Metacritic has it at 96 at the time of this writing. If you’re looking to add this new Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive to your collection, today is your last chance to save $10 on a preorder . While preorders have sold out at Amazon , physical copies with the textured foil cover are still available at Walmart for $59.88. That’s $10 less than physical copies cost everywhere else .

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2) Is $10 Off

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2)

Just like all of Walmart’s preorder discounts on physical Switch 2 games, the deal will go away once the game comes out. And it comes out tomorrow, November 5.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a from-the-ground-up remake of the 1998 Nintendo 64 classic. While it hews close to the original in many respects, it brings modern graphics, movement, and camera controls to the party, among other quality-of-life improvements. And because the bones of the game are so sturdy, this new reimagining is a fantastic adventure that will appeal to newcomers and longstanding fans alike.

In IGN's Ocarina of Time review , Nintendo expert Logan Plant wrote, “The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is both an exceptional remake of an incredible game and a rich adventure that stands on its own. This remake proves there’s still so much value in the traditional Zelda formula: the dense, intimate world of Hyrule is stuffed with charming characters and fascinating secrets. Its intricate dungeons are satisfying to unravel, even if their somewhat streamlined design has slightly dulled the special feeling that comes from solving them. Still, the depth, quality, and attention to detail in every corner match the lofty reputation of this series. Whether you’ve played the original 100 times, once back in 1998, or never at all, I highly recommend this beautiful retelling of a legend.”

articles.title: New Hogwarts Legacy Trailer Shows Off Nvidia's DLSS 5 Enhanced Lighting and Materials
articles.summary: Nvidia just showed off DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy in a new video that shows how its AI-enhanced lighting and materials model looks in-game. It’s a much more subtle effect compared to the images and clips going around after a leaked early version of DLSS 5 was modded into games.
articles.body:
Nvidia just showed off DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy in a new video that shows how its AI-enhanced lighting and materials model looks in-game. It’s a much more subtle effect compared to the images and clips going around after a leaked early version of DLSS 5 was modded into games .

Before, it looked like those yassification filters that were popular for like a week. It smoothed characters over, weirdly made some look about 30 years older, and generally warped the intended art style into something uncanny.

“On Thursday, November 5th, in collaboration with Warner Bros. Games and Avalanche Software, Hogwarts Legacy is updating the game to integrate DLSS 5 technology to enhance the lighting and materials, and use DLSS 5’s model controls to boost environmental uplift while preserving character identity,” Nvidia said.

According to the gargantuan tech company, DLSS 5 isn’t just a switch to be flipped — developers have to fine tune it and approve before release to hit the desired effect. It isn’t just about characters’ faces either. With the Neural Rendering option enabled, Nvidia claims shadows pop more, textures are upscaled, and reflections are sharper as the tech works in real-time to paint over the scene. You can see how it looks in Hogwarts Legacy in the video below.

This month, DLSS 5 and its 3D-Guided Neural Rendering will be added to three new games: Hogwarts Legacy, War Thunder, and Where Winds Meet. Hogwarts Legacy will be upgraded to DLSS 5 on November 5, and War Thunder will upgrade later in mid-November. DLSS 5 will be available immediately for players on Where Wind Meets on launch on November 23.

DLSS 5 only works with GeForce RTX 50-Series GPUs and laptops, RTX Spark PCs, and GeForce NOW Ultimate, Nvidia’s cloud streaming games service.
